title: The Voice Note From Tomorrow (Part 1) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine your best friend sends you a voice note at two a.m.
You almost ignore it. Then you see the time it was sent.
You play it. It's your friend, whispering.
"Don't open the door when I knock. It won't be me."
You laugh. It's a prank. He loves pranks.
The next night, you can't sleep. You keep checking the clock.
"Hey, it's me. Open up, it's freezing out here."
It's his voice. It's exactly his voice.
Your phone buzzes. A new voice note. From tomorrow again.
You play it with your hand shaking.
*"You didn't open it, right? Good. Because I'm not at your door. I'm under your bed."
Part two is coming next. Follow, so you don't miss it.
